name: iozy
description: Root shortcuts only. No workspaces: each folder keeps its own package.json and lockfile.

scripts.check: npm run check:kit && npm run check:web && npm run check:play
scripts.check:web: npm --prefix iozycore/web test && npm --prefix iozycore/web run typecheck && npm --prefix iozycore/web run lint
scripts.check:play: npm --prefix iozyplay run typecheck && npm --prefix iozyplay run lint && npm --prefix iozyplay test && npm --prefix iozyplay run test:unit
